**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

The document contains no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binding Teleglobe USA Inc.:

- **The single "exclusive" hit (Paragraph 27.1, p0262)** is the sole-and-exclusive *dispute remedy*. That is a forum/remedy mechanic belonging under GOVLAW, not exclusive dealing — flagging it here would double-count the same commercial term.
- **Paragraph 12 (Acquisition and Use of Capacity)** is an allocation/activation mechanic. Paragraph 12.1 restricts *who may use* APCN 2 capacity (carriers only); Paragraph 12.27 affirmatively permits a Party to sell sub-STM-1 capacity "at any time." Neither restrains us from sourcing or providing capacity elsewhere.
- **Paragraph 17.4** runs in our favour (Terminal Parties pledge not to impede Direct Access), so it is not flagged.
- Independent searches for "exclusivity", "sole supplier/source", "requirements from", "shall not procure/purchase from any third party", "shall only", "solely", and "other cable systems" surfaced no sourcing covenant.

Because the preferred element ("Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation") is satisfied by the absence of any such covenant, there is nothing to narrow to the fallback and no proposal was made.
